title: RARE 1.1.0 — Android release
description: Signed release APK built from the permanent RARE release key and pointed at the production backend.
changelog: Served APK is now the newest signed build, not a stale committed binary
versionCode raised so this installs over any earlier RARE build
Signed v1+v2+v3 with the permanent release certificate
Android client targets the production backend

title: RARE 1.1.1 — in-app updater and Android fixes
description: Adds the native package-installer bridge so in-app updates actually apply, and fixes the update path end to end.
changelog: In-app updates now hand the verified APK to Android's installer instead of only saving a file
Added REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES so the app can apply its own updates
Update dialog reports the real install result reported by Android
Signed v1+v2+v3 with the permanent release certificate
